## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

Every FAIL, PARTIAL and item-text-drift note extracted; each checked on `origin/main`. Two cosmetic oddities the run itself dismissed were judged genuine non-issues and not filed.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `scaffold-first-run` (FAIL) | 4/6 published templates fail first `npm run build` — namespace prefix not rewritten on object literals | **#7644** | `finding` + `target:v17` |
| `build-own-contract` c4 (PARTIAL) | exit-code-2 disagreement with `flag-command-error-ux` — clause should narrow to the #4873 duration-leak it was written for | #7648 | `domain:devx` |
| `dev-boot-contract` c2 | item-text drift — names retired `.objectstack/data/dev.db` / `resolveDefaultDevDbUrl`, superseded by unified `objectstack.db` | #7650 | `domain:devx` |
| side-observation (run declined to file) | runtime bundle filename hash differs across byte-identical inputs — possible non-deterministic build | #7651 (UNCONFIRMED) | `domain:cli` |
| cosmetic ×2 | "1 table(s) to create … 0 change(s)" summary line | not filed (non-issue) | — |

The 4 PASS items produced no cards.

### ⚠️ #7644 is not a code card — it is a RELEASE gate on v17, and it is the sharpest item in this whole batch

The code fix already exists on `origin/main` (`rewrite-identity.ts` + `findStaleNamespacePrefixes`, `rewrite-identity.test.ts` 10/10, the `#4902` incident named in its own comment). But **npm `latest` is still `create-objectstack@16.1.0`**, so *today* every new user who picks a non-blank template (`todo`/`compliance`/`content`/`contracts`) gets a project that fails on its **first build** — the worst possible first-run experience, and CI's own `canary-app` hits it. Two residual asks, both yours: confirm the fix ships in the 17.0.0 release, and confirm the nightly registry canary goes green once it does. `target:v17` applied.

Provenance: maintainer standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463.
